# Sample Procurement Directive

## 1. Purpose

This synthetic document exists only to test retrieval. It is not Government of Canada policy.

## 2. Competition

### 2.1 Default to competition

Contracting authorities should solicit bids from suppliers whenever a requirement can be met by more than one supplier. Open bidding through the electronic tendering service is the preferred method.

### 2.2 Exceptions to competition

A contract may be awarded without competition when the need is a pressing emergency, when the estimated value is below the low-dollar threshold, when only one supplier is capable of performing the work, or when competition would not be in the public interest. The reason must be recorded on the file.

## 3. Publication of contracts

Contracts with a value over ten thousand dollars are published on the open data portal each quarter. Amendments that change the value by more than ten thousand dollars are also published.

## 4. Conflict of interest

Officials involved in a procurement must declare any personal or financial interest in a bidding supplier and withdraw from the evaluation.
